name: Ahaziah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Jehoram sleeps with his fathers and is buried in the city of David, and Ahaziah his son reigns in his place.

note.label: 2 Kings 8: The Prophet Weeps Over Israel's Coming Affliction

points: Ahaziah son of Jehoram begins to reign over Judah and walks in the way of the house of Ahab, being the son-in-law of that house, a picture of the generational curse passed from father to son.

note.label: 2 Kings 8: The Prophet Weeps Over Israel's Coming Affliction

points: Jehoram returns to Jezreel to be healed, and Ahaziah goes down to see him, setting the stage for both kings to meet Jehu's judgment.

note.label: 2 Kings 8: The Prophet Weeps Over Israel's Coming Affliction

points: He rides toward Jezreel where Jehoram lay wounded, and Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see him.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Ahaziah king of Judah flees but Jehu pursues and has him smitten in his chariot; he flees to Megiddo and dies there.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Jehu meets the brethren of Ahaziah going to salute the king's children and has all forty-two of them slain at the pit of the shearing house, guilty by association with the house of Ahab.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw her son was dead, she moved to destroy all the royal seed so she could seize the throne.

note.label: 2 Kings 11: The Hidden King and the Covenant to Be the Lord's People

points: But Jehosheba took Joash, the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and hid him and his nurse in the house of the Lord six years. They had to hide that little boy, cuz this is how wicked women are: to stay in power, they'll destroy the men.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehosheba, sister of Ahaziah, took the infant Joash and stole him away from among the king's sons who were being slain, hiding him in the house of the Most High for six years while Athaliah reigned.

note.label: 2 Kings 11: The Hidden King and the Covenant to Be the Lord's People

points: Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria and did evil, following the sins of Jeroboam.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

points: The Most High stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and the Arabians that were near the Ethiopians, and they came up into Judah and carried away all his substance, his sons, and his wives, leaving only Jehoahaz his youngest.
The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, Jehoram's youngest son, king in his stead, for the band of Arabians had slain all the elder sons.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: Ahaziah was forty and two years old when he began to reign and reigned one year in Jerusalem, and his mother's name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: He went down to see the wounded Jehoram at Jezreel, and the destruction of Ahaziah was of the Most High, for by going he came into the path of Jehu, whom the Most High had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: That same Jehu who killed the seventy sons of Ahab found the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah's brethren and slew them, then sought and caught Ahaziah, who was hid in Samaria.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: They buried Ahaziah for the sake of Jehoshaphat his forefather who sought the Most High with all his heart; but the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep the kingdom, so the wicked king was cut off by the same hand the Most High anointed to avenge Israel.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: But Jehoshabeath the daughter of king Jehoram, wife of Jehoiada the priest and sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, hiding him and his nurse in a bedchamber.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah
